Our disciplines

Three engineering domains we know from the inside

  • Software & IT

    Developers, architects and platform engineers who build and run software, from cloud products to the embedded code inside machines.

    Typical roles

    • Backend developer
    • Frontend developer
    • Full-stack developer
    • Embedded software engineer
    • Software architect
    • DevOps engineer
    • Platform engineer
    • Cloud architect
    • Data engineer
    • QA automation engineer

  • Featured niche

    Cybersecurity

    Security specialists who protect networks, cloud platforms, products and industrial plants, and who help companies meet their regulatory duties.

    Typical roles

    • Security engineer
    • Security architect
    • SOC analyst
    • Penetration tester
    • Incident response analyst
    • Cloud security engineer
    • OT security engineer
    • GRC and compliance specialist
    • CISO

    • See how we help technical leaders Cybersecurity

  • Mechanical & industrial

    Design, process, automation and quality engineers for manufacturing, machinery and industrial plants.

    Typical roles

    • Mechanical design engineer
    • R&D engineer
    • Process engineer
    • Automation engineer
    • PLC programmer
    • Production engineer
    • Quality engineer
    • Maintenance manager
    • Lean manufacturing specialist
    • Plant manager
